name: TUUS Solutions
investors: Venture Kick (programme funding); Fondation pour l'Innovation et la Technologie (FIT; lender)
grants: Venture Kick: CHF 150,000 announced May 27, 2026; FIT: CHF 100,000 Tech Seed loan, not a grant; GENILEM and Innosuisse coaching/support displayed on company website.
awards: START Lausanne overall jury award, reported by the founder.
one_line: Develops HyCORE, a patent-pending plant-derived hydrogel for controlled nutrient delivery through B2B licensing and co-development.
red_flags: Company LinkedIn reports founding in 2025; Swiss legal entity TUUS Solutions Sàrl was registered March 10, 2026. Sàrl is normalized to GmbH. Publicly verified support is CHF 150,000 Venture Kick plus a CHF 100,000 FIT loan; no verified USD total is supplied. Website describes ongoing validation, including a York University trial begun in June 2026, rather than a publicly purchasable product. No specific open vacancies, pricing page or named paying customers were found; general invitations to join and research partners are not counted. An EPFL doctoral-student listing does not establish a completed founder PhD. Imprint status and an exhaustive trailing-12-month press count could not be verified.

name: calmea
founders: Alexander Breuss; Manuel Fujs; Levin Engeli; Leo Andrin Küng
grants: Venture Kick: CHF 150,000 announced June 8, 2026; BRIDGE Proof of Concept fellowship associated with Alexander Breuss; Innosuisse coaching; Swissnex Academia Industry Training 2026–2027 participant. Company interview also reports SNSF and Innosuisse support during preceding ETH research, not necessarily grants awarded to the incorporated company.
one_line: ETH Zurich spin-off developing an embedded bed-sensor module and software for contactless sleep monitoring and adaptive bedroom control.
red_flags: Kickfund portfolio membership confirms an institutional backer, but its investment amount and a complete financing total are undisclosed; the requested funding-size category therefore remains UNKNOWN. Public materials describe prototype installations and pilot preparation, not an openly purchasable product. Waitlist flag represents the website's consumer-launch notification list. No specific advertised vacancies, public pricing or named paying customers were found. Robert Riener is identified as scientific advisor, not one of the four founders; his credentials are not attributed to founders. Trailing-12-month press count could not be verified exhaustively.

name: Altiscreen
investors: Kickfund; Venture Kick (programme funding); DayOne (accelerator support)
grants: Venture Kick: CHF 150,000 announced December 15, 2025; DayOne accelerator participant. Public company pitch dated March 30, 2026 lists an CHF 80,000 DayOne non-dilutive grant and other foundation financing; its financing roadmap also includes prospective amounts that are not treated as closed funding.
one_line: Develops and markets handheld drug-screening analyzers for rapid on-site testing in law enforcement, workplaces and healthcare.
red_flags: Swiss entity is Altiscreen Sàrl, normalized to GmbH; the website separately identifies a French SASU branch. Official Venture Kick announcement states CHF 150,000, not an independently verified CHF 200,000 cumulative award. Kickfund backing is confirmed, but the complete financing total and whether it exceeds USD 500,000 are unverified. A March 30, 2026 pitch sought CHF 1.8 million and reported commitments; planned rounds and commitments are not counted as completed funding. Product-live flag reflects an offered field demo and commercial product inquiries, not self-service checkout. Team estimate uses eight people listed in that dated pitch and may not reflect subsequent departures or hires. Leonard Dumea is identified as MD; this does not establish a PhD. No specific open vacancies or named paying customers were verified. Imprint status and an exhaustive trailing-12-month press count remain unknown.
